data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic and Persian words 'Arya' (noble, man of honor) and 'An' (mountain), Aryano means mountain man or hero. This name is perfect for a boy who embodies strength, courage, and nobility. The name Aryano carries the meaning “Mountain man, hero, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Persian. Parents who choose Aryano usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain man, hero, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
